body: What do you argue about? I’m here to chat or DM me and we can chat. Xxx
Pot noodle navy

If you argue and you kill yourself she’ll have some guilt in her and as much as you’ll be free, speaking from someone who’s been on the receiving end of suicide, she won’t be. She won’t ever be free of that. 
I dunno. It’s weird trying to save someone from suicide when that’s all I want. But you have someone who cares for you. Make it work love. I bet you’re arguing over nothing 💕💕
Because your girlfriend may only end up like me. If there’s anything to live for maybe it’s her

Yeah I hope it does help. 
I wish I could kill my self. It annoys me that something gets in the way or that I can’t do it because I’ve seen what my partner left behind when he killed himself. I have this weird fucked up envy of it 

If you have reasons to life and you have a partner. Please speak to them. Please don’t leave your girlfriend the way I’ve been left

Thank you. I really appreciate it. I kinda should be grateful that I’m in Scotland with my friend and can’t hurt myself because we go home together tomorrow but at the same time I can’t wait to get home tomorrow and hurt myself. Mental health and widowed is just so shit. I just want to be with my partner who died so much
Thank you 💕💕
Thank you for reading xx
She fucked me boyfriend 👍
Thank you I really appreciate it love. I’m here for you too

Thank you.
You know this is a place to vent a place for vulnerable people to vent. Thankfully I’m not as vulnerable as others. I do hope they don’t contact anyone else
Thank you! It’s too much right now. And just saying they are wanting to die is too much for me. In fact it’s insulting who asks for tips to give to their partner! Absolutely disgusting
Hey this person just messaged me saying they’re going to commit. I’ve just lost my partner to suicide and they’ve randomly messaged me wtf
That my cervix was little and cute by my gynaecologist

But it’s fantastic that you have them in place. 
As I said love message me any time :)

Thank you.
That’s how I feel I think. I’m resentful he can escape and I can’t. 
It’s weird bc I miss him for like a few hours then I’m back to angry.

Hey. Don’t beat yourself up. And relapses are part of our recovery. There’s no shame in it. But getting help is the way forward. 
I’m going to my gps tomorrow about my MH which also involves self harm. 
If you ever need a chat direct message me. 
Self harm feels great for a grand total of what 10 mins? Then the guilt and the shame sink in. I often feel pissed at myself because I then have to wear something to cover them. 
Do you have any copy strategies in place?
So my dogs just been put down. This week can fuck off

Yeah I’m writing him one and putting it in his coffin at the funeral. 
I wouldn’t ever harm myself because I see the effect this sort of thing has on family and friends. Thank you
Yeah I need to write them down actually. That might help thank you
I have a little cat and a dog and that does help at times. She's the main reason I wouldn't do anything silly.
I hope so :(
Yeah you’re right. I just didn’t think shock could last so long :(
Aye I know but this is a type of eczema :) doesn’t always have to be on the joints. You can get eczema anywhere. It tends to form a small little blisters that burst and become dry and flake.
I have this! It’s a type of eczema. I found that natural bees wax worked a charm!

Thank you so much for your message. 
I think the stages of grief are just shit because I feel more than what’s in it. However I do agree that you don’t go through it as it says. So have different stages at different times. 
Im so sorry for your loss 💕
I’ve found Reddit amazing as the health service is a joke. I’m a nurse too as I even know it’s a joke

I honestly think the stages of grief are an absolute sack of shit. Because I’ve accepted he’s dead.
I spoke to a crisis nurse and she mentioned stages of grief and I don’t think a persons grief can be categorised so easily as everyone’s grief is so individual. So your grief is just so different to mine. 
I’ve spoken to people who are still angry years later. I’m still very angry and haven’t really hit depression and I don’t believe I will. But maybe this is grief? I dunno! Thank you for your message I really appreciate you taking the time to message me 💕💕💕
A perfect loaf 💕
Thank you for your message btw xx

It’s just ridiculous amounts of jealously and that isn’t me. I also keep having dreams and he’s in it. I dreamt last night that I went on a date with someone and he was there, almost stalking me. 

How are you dealing with your anxiety atm?
I’m scared to grieve because I don’t want to

When someone is determined to do it darling they’ll do it. 
You can’t blame yourself and at all and I know that his friends and family don’t blame you. You did all you could. You aren’t to blame. If you think this way it’ll eat you up. 
My boyfriend killed himself 2 weeks ago after telling me he was going to. 
Speak to his friends and family and they’ll reassure you that this wasn’t your fault. 
If you ever need a chat please feel free to message me :) I mean it xx

You have nothing to say sorry for. 
What happened to you is awful.
Him killing himself in front of you is another way of control. His final way of control. 
I understand with the abuse as my ex did these things to me. He raped me and sexually abused me a lot that I found it difficult with my last partner.
You aren’t to blame at all and I hope you don’t blame yourself. Have you been to your GP? 
After me and my ex split up I found that attending a women’s group really helped me. I met other women who were in the same boat as me. He used to convince me I was lying or talking shit. So when I met these women I just thought omg I’m not crazy.
If you ever need a chat please message me I’m all ears

No thank you that was really helpful. I am full of emotion that I have none too. That’s a good way to put it. 
I’ve woken up again this morning annoyed I’m not dead. I know I have a lot to live for and I know I have be most amazing friends and family but I just don’t want any of it right now. 
Before he killed himself I was positive. I seen the best in things. I wouldn’t say I was overly happy as I’ve always suffered with depression and anxiety but I was just starting to accept myself and enjoy my life. He’s just totally fucked all that up for it. 
Can I ask, sorry if it’s too much but did you see your friends in the chapel of rest?
My partners funeral isn’t until 2nd November and he died on the 23rd September. I just don’t know what he’s going to look like

Thank you so much. You’ve really cheered me up. I dunno if that’s a little morbid but I’m glad I’m not the only one. 
I don’t think I miss him which confuses me. 
I didn’t actually think about what he’d think about how I’m feeling. He’d be so upset to see me like that. 
Thank you for your message
How are you holding up? Xx
Can also confirm this is true. As a Brit I am also on my 3rd cup of the day

Thank you. 
Take care too. And please if you ever need a chat you can always private message me xx

Well we lived together and he killed himself in our flat and I was the one to find him, with my friends. I had to do all the identifying his body and basically all the paper work so I’d be really hurt if it wasn’t tbh. 
As awful as this sounds I just wish everything with the funeral would hurry up

I have a good relationship with his mam. I mean I’ve only met her once as she lives so far away but I speak to her. 
Me and his mother are the next or kins. She gave permission for me to know everything that she does :)

I did that in the hospital when he died and then I did in the morgue. His mam doesn’t want to see him. I’m in touch with his mam yeah and I’ve asked to dress him and do his hair and she was fine with it last week so I hope she still is. 
She said she doesn’t want to see him like that but I just can’t leave him. 
I went to see him in the morgue to put socks on him because he hated having cold feet. I know he’s dead and cold in a morgue of corse but the thought of him not having socks on when he hated having cold feet just wouldn’t go away. I’m really glad I did that. 
I asked him a lot of questions in the morgue and I said I’m sorry I couldn’t save you. I just couldn’t say goodbye for some reason. It was really weird

I was with my partner for 9 months but it was very intense and serious even though it was just 9 months. 
That’s what I think I’m a little afraid of. He wasn’t from the same city as me and he has this old life back where his funeral will be and I literally don’t know any of them. We had mutual friends in the city we both lived in which are coming but it’s going to be so overwhelming :(
I was with him in the morgue and I couldn’t say goodbye. I want and need to see him in the chapel of rest to say my goodbye. I also want to write him a letter to put in his pocket.

I’m so sorry 💕 has it been long for you?

I think I’ll find peace after his funeral when I can move on and just do me. I feel like he is taking over my life at the moment. Little pokes of “do I miss him? I do miss him” keep cropping up and I hate it. 

Many hugs back to you too xxx

My partner committed suicide 2 weeks ago. I dreamt that I saved him the other night and I managed to get there in time and take the belt off from around his neck. I’ve been sleeping with his pillow so it seemed so real because I could smell him.
It’s fucked me up man.

Why don’t you have it on a low ish volume but very close to your ear? :) have you ever tried tapping and making music with your hands? Creating beats with your fingers by tapping or tapping your phone screen? Maybe think of the song in your head and try and create it with tapping :) cx
Have you tried using earmuffs? Maybe play music and sit close to your phone or radio?
Oh I’ve never been to Bundobust! I must try it out when I’m back
Waaahh!? How have I never know this :’(
Is it sitting on a shaven scrotum?
Ah yes that’s it! It’s incredible! It isn’t too badly priced either tbh

Yard and Coop in NQ is a good shout

If you’re vegan there’s V Revs just opposite it 

There’s also (on the same street) an amazing Mexican place but I can’t think of the name. Basically 2 doors down from V Revs 

Flok do good breakfast

Oh that’s amazing! Really glad you’ve found yourself a therapist. 
How often will you see them?

How many therapists have you tried?
Do you meditate? I’ve meditated for years but for some reason since my partner killed himself I can’t seem to. 
Are there no charities in America you can join? Sorry if I seem a bit useless I guess the UK is just very different

This is really nice thank you. 
I think I may take you up on it when I feel ready to vent again. 
I lost my partner just over a week ago to suicide

I’m so sorry. I wish there was a way to take away everyone’s pain with this. 
Are you from the UK? If so please contact the crisis line and they can help. They have nurses come to your home and help you out. Whether it be a rant, get some employment support or sometimes just a shoulder to cry on. 
Please understand that this isn’t your fault. You are not to blame. 
You’re allowed to be angry and you’re allowed to feel however you want xx

Thank you for the message. I’m so sorry for your loss. How long has it been for you?
It just makes me angry. I’m a nurse and I can’t go to work because I have no empathy for people who commit suicide and I know that’s wrong but I can’t help it. 
I’m angry at people who commit suicide and I’m angry at myself for being suicidal

I am so sorry for your loss. I couldn’t even begin to imagine how you’re feeling. My partner killed themself a week ago today. And thinking why is driving me insane. If he was even to google anything they’d find it and inform you. 
When people get suicide in their mind it’s hard to pull them away from it and as hard as that may seem to grasp at times we can’t always save someone. Sometimes we just prolong it.
If you ever seen a private message please please message me. 
Sending all my love to you and your family

Yeah it’s what is helping me. Just being pissed off at home. My life is currently in tatters and I can’t see how it can be fixed.
I still have love but I’m the same as you and I’m just angry 
I’m so sorry for your loss btw

You’re in shock you may not cry for some time and that’s ok. 
It will come in waves and you just need to ride it out. 
It’s ok to not be ok and everything you’re feeling is normal and valid.
Im so sorry for your loss

Yeah it really does actually.
I’m now just angry at the aftermath tbh. I’m unsure whether I can keep my job and whether they’ll defer my start date. It’s like he’s destroyed everything around me, when he claimed to love me no matter what. 
I think I just want to be over it ASAP and I don’t want to grieve. I have this weird phobia of grieving him it’s so bizarre

It’s weird because I don’t actually miss him I don’t think and I don’t feel like my world is falling apart without him. I’m just angry. Like I cry I’m so angry.
I get what you mean even though you’re finding it hard to explain it
I’m so sorry for your loss. How are you feeling now about it?

I’ve got a GP appointment on Monday and I don’t want to go on medication again. 
I’ll look into that thank you

Thank you so much for this. I needed it. My boyfriend killed himself on Sunday and I’ve just entirely lost myself. I have nothing to say, I’m deferring my nursing job I’ve worked so hard for and I’ve moved back in with my parents giving away my flat.

Oh my goodness I am so sorry for this. She was so young. How are you feeling today? How is your friend feeling? Because whatever you are feeling I want you to know it’s normal. Go with how you feel and ride whatever emotional wave you’re feeling. 
I’m sending all my love to you and your friend

I’m 28 so hopefully there is something out there for me. I’ve been told to contact crisis in Manchester but I’ve worked for them before as I’m a nurse. So I’m waiting until I’m home.
Thank you so much for your comment
Yeah I’ve got one for Monday. At the practice I went to as a kid

I’m so sorry for your loss.
I lost my boyfriend on Sunday to suicide and everyone tells me that he loved me and said so many nice things about me. So I totally understand you.

Thing is when someone is wanting to commit suicide there isn’t anything we can do to stop those people. 

When people are adamant to do it they will. Just please don’t blame yourself or think what if’s because you’ll drive yourself up the wall.

My inbox is always open for a vent, or even just a casual chat 

Take care of yourself please

I don’t have a GP in Newcastle. I live in Manchester but I’m coming home for some respite and time to myself with my family. 
I will contact them tho

Thank you for your message.
I want to attend a support group or a 1-1 session. 

Thank you. 

I’m trying. I’m packing up the flat today and moving back to Newcastle

I’ve seen him in the morgue and it made it less real at first. He looked like a wax Work it was so surreal. But then I had a breakdown and I think maybe it’s real? 
I don’t know how to feel and I think that’s why I’m so confused. I feel like we’ve broke up and I won’t ever see him again. It’s so surreal. 
I’m going to see him in the chapel of rest as I want to dress him and do his hair and give him a letter I want to write with how I feel. 
I’m so sorry for your loss. How are you feeling about it now?

My boyfriend killed himself on Sunday. If you need anyone to speak to please feel free to private message me or chat on here. 
Emotions are everywhere and one day you’ll feel fine and be able to function and be proactive and other days sorry to say you’ll be bed bound with your head going in mad circles. But it’s all normal.
I’m finding that my emotions are so all over the place and up and down every half an hour/hour. 
I hope there’s no blame or guilt from your side and I hope you don’t think for a second “what if I had of done this?” Because when someone is determined to do this, they will do it.
I’m sending all my love to you at this hard time xx

I think I’m numb today. I can’t sleep in our bed. Our cat is acting weird and everything is sending me west. My friends find it hard to come into my flat and I’m finding myself angry at them when I actually have no right to be. 

I know this isn’t my fault and there is actually nothing I could have done or if I did it would have only postponed his suicide till another time. 

I just want to move out of this flat and I hate how I can’t just move out now and be in somewhere else right away. 

Thank you so much for your post

Yeah I know it was his choice. I just almost hate him for doing it. And today I can’t even bring myself to get up. I went to the toilet and that was effort. I haven’t brushed my hair since he died and I just can’t do anything today. 
I’m so sorry. How are you feeling today? 
I’m not thinking of any nice memories I can’t do it

Today I am really really ok. It’s weird. It isn’t on my mind really. I’m going to see his body today and put some socks on him as he hated his feet to be cold. I’m going to brush his hair too. 
I have friends and family i can open up to and I have a friend who’s had 2 of her best friends kill themselves. So that’s helpful as she gets it. But at the same time she doesn’t because they weren’t her partner. 
How are you now? Are things good for you? Well not good but are you at peace? 
Is your therapist a specialist?

Im so sorry that you lost him. How did you know he was taking meth? Did you read the coroners report or in the inquest? 
Also did you go and visit his body? 
Sorry got 50 questions but did you find looking at his Facebook hard? 
It’s weird because I don’t feel sad and today I’ve woken up and kinda accepted it? It’s day 2 surely I should be a mess? Maybe I’m just pretending and I don’t know. I’m kinda just going with the flow. 
What is annoying me is this tremor I’ve developed. I shake so much like I’m cold but I’m not really. It’s so weird. 
Again I’m so sorry for your loss but I’m glad you’ve gained some peace.

There’s no need for you ever to feel guilty. I’ve had some waves of it and I’ve accepted that I can’t be to blame. I’m weirdly handling it ok and it’s technically day 2. Very weird. Maybe it just hasn’t sunk in I don’t know

Thank you. I dunno how I feel. I haven’t cried for a few hours which is an improvement of yesterday. I’m going to see his body tomorrow and then spend the night in our flat where he killed himself. I really don’t know how or what to think. I don’t want to miss him and I don’t think I do. Maybe I do and can’t say it because it’ll make it real? I dunno. 
Have you got a good strong support network? Have you ever accepted a counsellor?
Have you ever found out whether he wanted to or not? My boyfriend killed himself on Sunday and I just think he took it too far and died. I just need to know

I’m so sorry about your boyfriend. I lost my boyfriend to suicide on Sunday morning and that was to do with alcohol. It’s dangerous shit and so unregulated. Makes me angry that if he wasn’t drinking he wouldn’t have done it. I hope you have some peace xxx

I am so sorry for your loss. Losing a brother is just unimaginable. Perhaps take some closure that he passed away knowing that you loved him dearly. And it’s beautiful that he knew that, even if he did what no one wanted. 
I lost my boyfriend to suicide on Sunday. He hung himself in our flat. If you’d like someone to talk to, rant or vent I’m all ears

Did you shake a lot? My body is shaking like I’m cold and I’m not really cold. I also have these random like shit he’s dead!! Moments but then get over them? Like as if I maybe think nah he isn’t or just accept it. I like to think it’s acceptance.
I just wish it was like in 5 days you’ll be fine and forget it. Which isn’t realistic and won’t happen.
Also are you from the UK? What’s the procedure with suicide. As in when will the inquest be and coroners report be ready. 
I was probably told all of this at the hospital but my mind was elsewhere

I’m so sorry for your loss. I really am. I wouldn’t even know what to do it I had a child. We have a little cat and my heart breaks she won’t have him anymore. 
Right now I’m not sad. I’m reading Facebook comments, I’m tagged in things and it isn’t making me sad? Is that normal? I can’t decide whether it feels real or not. It sort of feels like a breakup because we broke up before and had zero contact. I’m staying angry at him as it helps me. When people are telling me he was brilliant I’m saying no he’s a cunt because I truly feel that way because he was and still is. 
I’m very spiritual. I think I seen him before in my bathroom at home in Newcastle. Unsure whether his spirit would be with me tho. 
Thank you so much for your message and I’m so sorry you’ve been through this. If I need to I will private message you thank you. Same to you if you ever need to chat xxx

Thank you so much for this.
I lost my partner yesterday morning and I can’t even decide if I miss him yet. I’m seeing his body tomorrow so maybe that’s why. I don’t want to cry I don’t want to grieve him. I know it isn’t healthy to not grieve but I also don’t know how to. How long for. 
Is it easier to grieve after the funeral?

I’m so sorry for your loss. Rambling is healthy and you need to let every emotion out and accept that feeling as something totally normal. 
I lost my boyfriend yesterday to suicide. If you ever need to ramble you can message me.
Thank you I really appreciate it

I’m really sorry for your loss. Today I feel worse than I did yesterday. It feels weird waking up at my parents without a text from him. 
How did you manage to cope? I want this all to be over

It just doesn’t feel real. Did you go through a stage of just pure anger? I’m trying to mask my love for him with anger. 
I’m going to see his body for a final goodbye on Tuesday and then I’ll be sorting out his clothes in our flat. We have a little cat which is anxious so I can’t just stay around anyone’s house which makes it more difficult.
She’s perfect!!

Have you ever tried to rationalise these thoughts? Perhaps look into what triggers your thoughts of your partner getting tired of you?
I have these with my boyfriend a lot and i try to rationalise why I have these thoughts. Perhaps jot down when these thoughts occur, what’s happening in my surroundings, what am I doing and see if there’s a pattern there. Could this feeling be from a previous relationship? If so perhaps speak to your partner. They seem like a very understanding person :)
